name: sylvester
expr: X = sylvester(A, B, C); err = max(max(abs(A*X + X*B - C)));
comment: Sig: X = sylvester(A, B, C). Solves A*X + X*B = C. For symmetric A and B (this revision): simultaneous diagonalisation via eig. Residual to ulp. Extended in 2026-08 via Bartels-Stewart Schur algorithm for general real and complex matrices.
